description.narrative: The main objective of the proposed program is to improve the administration of justice by making it more accesible, equitable, dependable and efficient. The specific objectives are to help; (i) improve the institutional capacity for developing crime prevention policies and projects; (ii) ensure that the legal rights of the accused are protected; (iii) make prosecutorial activities more reliable and effective; (iv) reduce congestion in the judicial system; and (v) improve the administrative capacity of the judiciary.
